quotes.text: All these tabs that are open right now, whatever is watching the plan, that should also be swallowed up by the daemon. No need to see anything in a Rex tab that isn't doing agent work.

Detached child of the daemon: the daemon spawns rhiza run start as a background process with its output in a per-run log file under .git/rhiza; a run still outlives a daemon restart; each agent step opens its own Rex tab
All go through the daemon: the roadmap app and the CLI ask the daemon to start the run, so every driver is headless and counted against maxRuns; rhiza run start --foreground stays for debugging
Existing apps + log: add rhiza run log <run> and a key in the runs app that opens it in a Rex layer on demand

fields.summary: Mid-interview the owner added that the Rex tabs watching each plan or build run should move into the daemon too, so Rex shows only tabs doing agent work. Settled: a run's driver becomes a detached child process of the daemon with its output in a per-run log file, so a run still outlives a daemon restart; each agent step opens its own Rex tab; every run starts through the daemon, including the roadmap app's start keys and rhiza run start, with a foreground mode kept for debugging; progress shows in the existing apps plus rhiza run log and a runs-app key that opens the log. This becomes a fourth change set of the milestone, planned now.
fields.title: Milestone 24 plan, part two: run drivers move into the daemon
